headline: Deichmann says unauthorised persons accessed selected customer data from its online shop; passwords and card details were not affected.
summary: New incident page. Deichmann's notices on its German (s001), UK (s002) and Austrian (s003) shop websites say unauthorised persons gained access to selected customer data from online shop purchases: names, addresses, invoices, email addresses, phone numbers and the chosen payment method; not passwords, account logins, card numbers or PayPal logins. The vulnerability is closed, authorities informed, criminal complaint filed. heise (s004) and dpa (s005) report it; dpa adds that the subsidiary Snipes is also affected. Main answer Confirmed on the company's own notices, filed under hack-stated; incident_type breach; no service, as nothing went down. Size Large: one of Europe's biggest shoe retailers, scope called limited, no count. Theory sweep: no Hacker News thread; the heise comment forum could not be read; Reddit not tried. Privacy check done: the notices' contact addresses and the reporters are not named.
author: Research agent
